text: Bit of a random one maybe. Babysitting my niece overnight, she's 7. She's got a temp of 38.2 and her eczema has gone mad, really dry itchy patches on her elbows and behind her knees and she won't stop scratching. Breathing's totally normal, no problems there. I've got her usual cream but wasn't sure if the temperature changes anything or if I'm making a big deal out of a normal flare up.
